verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe saving a login profile once and reusing it to start future browsers already logged in, plus a 2FA guide for handling the initial login flow, and community evidence confirms local profile reuse works for logged-in automation (e.g., LinkedIn). missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration specifically of the cloud profile-reuse feature (only local profile reuse is community-validated) and no detail on profile storage/security guarantees.
